# Digital Technology Partner

> Digital Technology Partner (DTP) helps leadership teams turn scattered AI activity into governed systems intended to create measurable operational value. DTP operates from Aberdeen and works remotely.

DTP's public site describes programmes, practical AI systems, a five-gate delivery process and a newsroom focused on AI adoption, governance, delivery and automation. Descriptions below reflect DTP's own published pages and should not be treated as independent validation of outcomes.

## Start here

- [Home](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/home/): DTP's proposition and approach to governed AI delivery.
- [Why DTP](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/why-dtp/): Delivery principles, governance and questions for prospective buyers.
- [Contact](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/contact/): Public contact routes and what to expect after making contact.

## Programmes

- [AI programmes](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/programmes/): Overview of DTP's public programmes.
- [AI Adoption Readiness Sprint](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/programmes/ai-adoption-readiness/): A one-week assessment of current AI use, risk, noise and opportunity.
- [AI Foundry](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/programmes/ai-foundry/): A twelve-week working group designed to turn experiments into evidence and leadership decisions, not a conventional course.
- [Leadership AI Coaching](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/programmes/leadership-ai-coaching/): Confidential, private, one-to-one coaching for senior leaders.

## Delivery and solutions

- [Process](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/process/): Five evidence gates: Discover, Prove, Build, Pilot and Launch, with a right to stop at each gate.
- [Solutions](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/solutions/): Dashboards, workflow automation, AI agents and bespoke AI or business systems designed around workflow, data, people and governance.

## Publications

- [Insights](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/insights/): DTP's editorial perspective and route to current material.
- [Newsroom](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/news/): Published articles about AI adoption, governance, delivery and automation.
- [Newsroom archive](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/news/archive/): Archive of approved public newsroom articles.

## Products

- [WhichLogin](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/apps/whichlogin/): A local-only macOS menu-bar app that records sign-in routes on the user's Mac.
- [10 Touches privacy policy](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/10-touches/privacy/): Public privacy information for a personal CRM whose production data stays locally on the device.
